verdict.rationale: Mastra Knowledge is a scoped, linked knowledge store that developer-built agents can read and update. Studio displays scopes, pages and a link graph, but nothing shows the product itself generating insights or suggestions from a user's data. The closest evidence, a research agent writing findings and agents updating pages, describes developer building blocks, not a built-in insights capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
